messages:
Alison: Partner Z wants marketplace listing for their secrets manager. Scope: SAML SSO, SCIM provisioning (group->role), KMS (BYOK + managed). Need quick triage.
Ravi: I'll own KMS checklist. Do they support AES-KW wrapping? Need their wrap algos and attestation.
Diego: SCIM uses 'roles' groupattr. Will supply mapping example. They also expose rotation webhooks returning opaque tokens.
Sasha: Product asks that partner-run shim is preferred. Marketing targets announcement in 12 days.
Alison: Ops: package + e2e tests needed. ops-bot, is the connector template still rdx-marketplace-v1?
ops-bot: @Alison yes: https://console.internal/templates/marketplace-secrets-connector tag rdx-marketplace-v1. e2e skeleton: https://console.internal/tests/marketplace-connector-e2e.
Diego: sample SCIM payload: {"userName":"svc-pz","externalId":"pz-1","groups":[{"value":"inference-ops"}]}
Diego: sample SAML metadata: <EntityDescriptor entityID="https://idp.partnerz.com"><IDPSSODescriptor>...cert...</IDPSSODescriptor></EntityDescriptor>
Ravi: Action items: Ravi: KMS attestation + wrap-algos (2d). Diego: SCIM/SAML snippets + shim POC (2d). Sasha: package & CI (3d). Alison: announcement draft (4d).
All: ack by EOD?
Diego: ack
Ravi: ack
Sasha: ack
Alison: created ticket INF-9999 and scheduling 15m sync. ops-bot: create ticket?
ops-bot: Created INF-9999 (partner-z marketplace onboarding) assigned to Alison,Ravi,Diego,Sasha. https://jira.internal/browse/INF-9999
Alison: closing thread, moving checklist to the ticket.
